text:
For **weekend tent camping**, I’d pick the **[BLUETTI Elite 30 V2 + 100W solar panel kit](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-30-v2-100w-solar-kit)**. It’s a more campsite-sized setup than the much larger home-backup kits: the 288Wh battery is suited to phones, lights, cameras, and other small electronics, while its 600W inverter can handle some higher-draw devices briefly. The included panel can refill it in about **four hours of good sun**, according to the [camping-kit comparison](https://dealectric.com/best-solar-generator-kit-for-tent-camping). The result lists it at **$489.99**; check the current price before buying.

The main limitation is battery capacity: it’s **not a good choice for electric cooking or heating**, or for running power-hungry gear all weekend. Set the panel in open sun—shade can sharply reduce charging.
